head_coach.name: Carlos Queiroz
head_coach.play_style_summary: An extremely organized, disciplined, and defensive-minded approach. Focuses on compressing space in a mid-to-low block, utilizing a solid flat back four, and launching rapid, direct counter-attacks in transition using pacey wingers.

key_players.name: Antoine Semenyo
key_players.performance_stats: Elite physical presence and direct goal threat. Transferred to Manchester City in 2026, he is known for high shot volume, an impressive dribbling success rate, and contributing a high percentage of his team's goals.

key_players.name: Abdul Fatawu
key_players.performance_stats: Incredibly dynamic and pacey winger with explosive acceleration. Recognized as a highly effective 1v1 dribbler and crosser for Leicester City. Winner of the EFL Championship Goal of the Month in August 2025.

key_players.name: Iñaki Williams
key_players.performance_stats: Renowned for blistering speed, exceptional longevity, and fitness. A tactically disciplined forward for Athletic Club who constantly stretches defenses with runs in behind and provides highly intense off-the-ball pressing.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Excluded from the 2026 World Cup squad after failing to recover from a serious quadriceps injury and subsequent surgery sustained in January 2026.
Ruled out of the tournament due to a ruptured anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) suffered during a Ligue 1 clash with Monaco in January 2026.
Sustained a late injury in training over the weekend just prior to the final World Cup squad deadline in early June 2026, resulting in him being replaced in the squad.
